<style>
/* ── Assistant shell — fixed overlay, no drag ──────────────────────────── */
.dm-assistant-shell {
  position: fixed;
  top: 74px;
  right: 24px;
  width: 420px;
  height: min(760px, calc(100vh - 90px));
  min-height: 560px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 90px);
  z-index: 1100;
  background: #111827;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dm-assistant-shell[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.dm-assistant-shell__header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
}

.dm-assistant-shell__eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #7dc6c6;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.dm-assistant-shell__header h2 {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f3f7fb;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.dm-assistant-shell__close {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: rgba(243,247,251,0.7);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 150ms ease;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dm-assistant-shell__close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

.dm-assistant-shell__frame {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;
  border: none;
  display: block;
  background: transparent;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .dm-assistant-shell {
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100dvh;
    min-height: 100dvh;
    max-height: 100dvh;
    border-radius: 0;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
var dmHomepageVoice  = null;
var dmSpeechUnlocked = false;

function pickHomepageVoice() {
  var voices = window.speechSynthesis ? window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() : [];
  if (!voices || !voices.length) return null;
  return (
    voices.find(function(v) { return v.name === 'Samantha'; }) ||
    voices.find(function(v) { return v.name === 'Daniel'; })   ||
    voices.find(function(v) { return /^en/i.test(v.lang); })   ||
    voices[0]
  );
}

function unlockHomepageSpeech() {
  if (!window.speechSynthesis) return false;
  window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  window.speechSynthesis.resume();
  var blank = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(' ');
  blank.volume = 0.01;
  blank.rate   = 2;
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(blank);
  dmSpeechUnlocked = true;
  return true;
}

function toggleHomepageAssistant(open) {
  var shell = document.getElementById('homepageAssistant');
  var frame = document.getElementById('homepageAssistantFrame');
  if (!shell || !frame) return;

  if (open) {
    unlockHomepageSpeech();
    dmHomepageVoice = pickHomepageVoice();
    shell.hidden = false;

    if (!frame.src) {
      frame.src = buildVoiceAssistantUrl({ embed: true, autostart: true });
      frame.onload = function () {
        if (frame.contentWindow) {
          frame.contentWindow.postMessage(
            { type: 'dm-start-assistant' },
            window.location.origin
          );
        }
      };
    } else if (frame.contentWindow) {
      frame.contentWindow.postMessage(
        { type: 'dm-start-assistant' },
        window.location.origin
      );
    }
  } else {
    window.speechSynthesis && window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    shell.hidden = true;
    frame.src    = '';   // reset so next open starts fresh
  }
}

window.addEventListener('message', function (event) {
  if (event.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
  if (event.data && event.data.type === 'dm-speech-unlock') {
    unlockHomepageSpeech();
  }
});

if (window.speechSynthesis) {
  window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = function () {
    dmHomepageVoice = pickHomepageVoice();
  };
}

window.addEventListener('load', function () {
  dmHomepageVoice = pickHomepageVoice();
});
</script>

<!-- APPROACH -->
<section class="dm-section">
  <div class="dm-container">
    <div class="dm-two-col">
      <div>
        <div class="dm-section-header">
          <h2>How we work</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="dm-approach">
          <p>Every deliverable is structured so that results can be independently verified. Code is version-controlled and documented. Assumptions are stated explicitly and tested against alternatives. Data provenance is recorded at every transformation step.</p>
          <p>We do not produce black-box outputs. Clients receive not only findings but the documented analytical chain that produced them — enabling internal review, regulatory examination, or downstream use by their own teams.</p>
        </div>
        <p class="dm-micro-proof">All outputs carry a documented audit trail from raw input to final result.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="dm-section-header">
          <h2>Working principles</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="dm-principles">
          <div class="dm-principle">
            <h3>Reproducibility by default</h3>
            <p>No manual steps without documentation. Pipelines are scripted, not assembled by hand.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="dm-principle">
            <h3>Explicit assumptions</h3>
            <p>Sensitivity analyses accompany every primary estimate. Uncertainty is quantified, not suppressed.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="dm-principle">
            <h3>Independence preserved</h3>
            <p>Analytical conclusions are not adjusted for client preference. Findings are reported as the data supports.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
